article.title: Reclaiming workers’ ownership over artificial intelligence and technologies
article.author: Editor
article.content: Contemporary anti-technology movements and different forms of resistance against big technology companies, data corporations, their data centres, and AI are often branded as Luddite movements, creating a historical parallel with the workers’ uprising in textile towns of England in 1779. The post Reclaiming workers’ ownership over artificial intelligence and technologies appeared first on MR Online .
